summary.content:
Today's selection covers 55 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 28 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: After Hugging Face Was Attacked By A.I. Agents, It Embarked on a Crusade
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Tricky 'SynkLoader' Multitool May Herald Ransomware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 39 articles published in the last 24 hours
